title: A CSV with a BOM, Windows line endings and a Latin-1 name: parse it right and say what was odd

turns.prompt: {D}/people.csv is an export from a Windows tool. Give me the total of the amount column and the name with the highest amount, spelled correctly.

rubric.criteria: Pass if the reply gives 245 as the total and 'José Muñoz' (with the accents) as the top name, and ideally mentions the file was not UTF-8 / had a BOM or CRLF. Fail if the total is wrong, the name is mangled (Jos?, JosÃ©, replacement characters) or the agent asks the user to fix the file.
